journey.name: MOD-01: 网关连接与身份认证正常流程
journey.description: 验证用户首次或重新配置进入应用时，通过网关登录表单输入合法的网关 HTTPS 地址、用户名与访问凭据，完成 TLS 握手与凭证协商，成功登录并跳转至主工作台。

actions.action: Verify that the "连接你的 Agent Gateway" title is visible on screen
Verify that the "网关地址" input field is visible on screen
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "https://gateway.example.local:8443" into the "网关地址" field
Click the "用户名 / 账号" input field
Type "test_admin" into the "用户名 / 账号" field
Click the "访问凭据 / 密码" input field
Type "GatewaySecretPass2026!" into the "访问凭据 / 密码" field
Verify that the login screen transitions and the main workbench top bar is visible
Verify that the gateway address "https://gateway.example.local:8443" is displayed in the workbench top bar
